models.name: Whisper Tiny
models.description: Smallest and fastest canonical Whisper model. Best for low-power machines and quick tests.
models.recommended_hardware: Any supported machine. Lowest memory and CPU requirements.

models.name: Whisper Base
models.description: Fast canonical Whisper model with better accuracy than tiny. Good baseline for CPU use.
models.recommended_hardware: Any supported machine. Suitable for CPU transcription.

models.name: Whisper Small
models.description: Balanced canonical Whisper model for everyday transcription on modest hardware.
models.recommended_hardware: 8GB+ RAM recommended. Usable on CPU; faster with GPU acceleration.

models.name: Whisper Medium
models.description: Higher-accuracy canonical Whisper model for users who can trade speed for quality.
models.recommended_hardware: 16GB+ RAM recommended. GPU acceleration recommended for frequent use.

models.name: Whisper Large v3
models.description: Highest-accuracy canonical Whisper model. Best quality, highest resource use.
models.recommended_hardware: 16GB+ RAM minimum; 32GB+ RAM or GPU acceleration recommended.

models.name: Whisper Large v3 Turbo
models.description: Fast large-v3-derived Whisper model with a strong speed/accuracy tradeoff. Recommended default local model.
models.recommended_hardware: 16GB+ RAM recommended. Good default for local transcription; GPU acceleration improves latency.

models.name: Whisper Tiny (English)
models.description: English-only Tiny model. A lightweight alternative to multilingual Tiny for English dictation.
models.recommended_hardware: Any supported machine. Lowest memory and CPU requirements.

models.name: Whisper Base (English)
models.description: English-only Base model. Fast English transcription on CPU.
models.recommended_hardware: Any supported machine. Suitable for CPU transcription.

models.name: Whisper Small (English)
models.description: English-only Small model for a balance of accuracy and resource use.
models.recommended_hardware: 8GB+ RAM recommended. Usable on CPU; faster with GPU acceleration.

models.name: Whisper Medium (English)
models.description: English-only Medium model for higher-accuracy English transcription.
models.recommended_hardware: 16GB+ RAM recommended. GPU acceleration recommended for frequent use.

models.name: Whisper Small Q5_1
models.description: 5-bit quantized Small model. Smaller download and lower weight memory, with a possible accuracy tradeoff.
models.recommended_hardware: 4GB+ RAM recommended. Suitable for CPU transcription.

models.name: Whisper Medium Q5_0
models.description: 5-bit quantized Medium model. Reduces weight memory and download size; accuracy may differ from full precision.
models.recommended_hardware: 8GB+ RAM recommended. GPU acceleration improves latency.

models.name: Whisper Large v3 Q5_0
models.description: 5-bit quantized Large v3 model. About one third of the full-precision download, with a possible accuracy tradeoff.
models.recommended_hardware: 8GB+ RAM recommended. GPU acceleration recommended for frequent use.

models.name: Whisper Large v3 Turbo Q5_0
models.description: 5-bit quantized Turbo model. Compact multilingual transcription with lower weight memory than full-precision Turbo.
models.recommended_hardware: 8GB+ RAM recommended. Usable on CPU; GPU acceleration improves latency.

models.name: Whisper Large v3 Turbo Q8_0
models.description: 8-bit quantized Turbo model. A less aggressive compression option than Q5_0, retaining a smaller download than full precision.
models.recommended_hardware: 8GB+ RAM recommended. Usable on CPU; GPU acceleration improves latency.

models.name: Distil-Whisper Large v3.5 (English)
models.description: English-only distilled Whisper model from the Distil-Whisper team, published in whisper.cpp-compatible GGML format.
models.recommended_hardware: 16GB+ RAM recommended. GPU acceleration improves latency.
